content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a NullPointerException (NPE) occurring in the `afterClass` method of the `SolrTestCaseJ4` class when attempting to close the core. This happened because the code was trying to call the `shutdown` method on `defaultClient` and `loadbalancer` without checking if they were null. If either of these objects was not initialized (i.e., null), it would lead to an NPE when the shutdown method was invoked. The patch added null checks for both `defaultClient` and `loadbalancer` before attempting to call their respective shutdown methods, thus preventing the NPE.
